entry.title: Project Fallen Angel
entry.summary:
Author: ClassActofLittleConsequence

Rating: MatureLanguage: EnglishWords: 88,326Chapters: 19/?Kudos: 128

Summary: At nineteen, you wake beneath a Siberian mountain with no name, no memories, and enough blood on your hands to know you may not want either back. Jason Todd finds you anyway. He carries you out of a facility filled with dead children while the mountain collapses around you, and for one brief, impossible moment, someone touches you without intending to hurt you. Then you wake up. You panic. And disappear. Five years later, Gotham has a new problem. Something with white wings is moving through the city like a ghost, slipping past cameras, dismantling criminal operations before Batman can reach them, and leaving bodies behind when mercy isn't deserved. Gotham is a city built on old secrets, and some things were buried for a reason. The deeper you dig into the life stolen from you, the more the past begins reaching back, and the harder it becomes to keep the quiet, ordinary life you've built from colliding with the weapon you were made to be. Especially when Jason Todd walks into it.
